about_the_game:
The Empire of Froge has fallen, but in your last stand, your comrades suddenly re-grow in numbers! This is Frogmageddon! A Bullet Heaven-style survival game where the more evil snakes you defeat, the larger your frog army grows (to the hundreds!).

Grow your army!

Every defeated snake poses an opportunity to amass more frogs. But watch out: each frog can only take one hit before being lost to the fires of war. Master your positioning to maximize the growth of your pond-dwelling platoon!

Weaponized Frogs!

More frogs means more damage! New frogs have a chance of spawning a variety of weapons to help in defeating the snake menace.

Discover the Liliad!

What led to the fall of the Frogean Empire? How can Frogean kind repopulate? Find out in the epic time-waster tale detailing the fall and hopeful return of the Frogean Empire!

Steam Exclusive Features!

  • Controller Support

  • Steam Achievements

  • Your friends will know you play Frogmageddon.

  • And many more!

Be the frog! Live the frog!

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
